detailed_descriptions.en: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center. Pick up, inspect, and sort thousands of unique packages by their size, colors, logos, labels, and special handling marks. Discover matching items, create neat stacks, and bring order to the chaos. From electronics and collectibles to fragile goods and special shipments, every package has its own identity. Pay attention to the details, find the right place for each box, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse. Sort. Stack. Satisfy.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.

Pick up, inspect, and sort thousands of unique packages by their size, colors, logos, labels, and special handling marks. Discover matching items, create neat stacks, and bring order to the chaos.

From electronics and collectibles to fragile goods and special shipments, every package has its own identity. Pay attention to the details, find the right place for each box, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

Sort. Stack. Satisfy.
